Balance of Terror (cut mission)

Balance of Terror is scenario 2 of a series of six scenarios of Etherlords that were never released. The texts of the series (MT_S01 to MT_S06) are filled in only in the English edition, which also has each briefing as the text of a spoken one; in the Russian edition the same texts are empty. No map of either edition uses them.

Briefing

The peace ends when new passes through the mountains open the way into the lands of the Chaots. The scouts find no Chaots there, and the Synthets, Vitals and Kinets begin to fight over the empty land.

In the game's own wiki, the full briefing from your copy of the game appears here (the Russian edition has none):

The conditions, as the English edition words them:

ConditionText
ObjectiveDestroy enemy Castles
VictoryDestroy enemy Castles
DefeatLose your Castle

What is known

Only the texts remain; no heroes, decks or program rules are tied to this map.

The series

The six scenarios: Savage Desert · Balance of Terror · First Strike · Ice Trap · Dragon Lake · Synthets Menace.
